codex.readyToCheck: Click "Run Environment Check" to start detecting local OpenAI Codex CLI environment
codex.step1: Ensure Node.js 22+ and npm are installed: https://nodejs.org/
codex.step2: Install Codex CLI: npm install -g @openai/codex (set HTTP_PROXY if using proxy)
codex.step3: Complete login: codex login --device-auth, then click "Enable" after checks pass to use Codex models in Agent dialog
codex.notInstalled: OpenAI Codex CLI not detected, please install it first
codex.notConfigured: OpenAI Codex not configured, please complete environment check and enable it in Settings
codex.installSuccess: Codex CLI installed successfully, please re-run environment check
codex.authOpened: Terminal window opened, please complete Codex login (device code authentication)
